# External exemplars · real McKinsey decks, for study only

Owner-directed source (2026-08-18): the curated index at
plusai.com/zh/blog/mckinsey-presentation-examples, which links publicly
hosted McKinsey presentations at their original institutional archives
(OECD, UN, USPS, World Bank, national ministries, industry bodies).

**These PDFs are NOT committed and NOT shipped** — the directory is
gitignored above this manifest. They are third-party copyrighted works,
downloaded from their public hosts for design study; nothing from them is
copied into a deliverable, and what the repository ships is the ORIGINAL
analysis derived from studying them (`references/exemplars/`'s annotated
design notes). Re-fetch list: `SOURCES.urls` beside this file.

18 of the index's 28 links resolved on 2026-08-18; the rest 403/404 at
their hosts.
